fields.description: These change how Frappe's desk behaves and depend on details of its code that an upgrade can change, so switch them off first if the desk misbehaves after an upgrade. Changes apply when each user reloads the page.

Turns the Dock, the column left of the sidebar, into a rail of apps: the Desk Apps, then each installed app Frappe lists on its Apps screen, with every module left over under Other. Picking an app offers its modules, as Module Picker says.
fields.label: Override Navigation Rail

fields.description: Where picking an app on the rail offers its modules. Header Menu: the menu at the top of the sidebar opens on the app's modules over the page you are on, the sidebar always holds the module's content, and the header names the app over its module. Sidebar List: the sidebar's rows become the app's modules until you pick one, and the header names the module over its app. Module Column: the app's modules get a column of their own between the rail and the sidebar, which folds to its icons and opens over the sidebar while pointed at; the sidebar always holds the module's content.
fields.label: Module Picker
fields.options:
Header Menu
Sidebar List
Module Column

fields.description: Arranges the icons on Frappe's Apps screen (/desk) from the Desk Apps, in rail order, as each Desk App's Apps Screen setting says. Only where Desktop Settings' Desktop Page is Apps: Frappe's older Desktop Icons grid is left as Frappe draws it. Turned off, Frappe's own Apps screen comes back.
fields.label: Override Desktop Icons
Move Search and Notifications to Rail
fields.description: Moves Search and Notifications, and any tiles other apps add there (such as To Do), from the top of the sidebar to the foot of the rail, where their drawers open beside the rail. Turned off, they stay where Frappe puts them. Needs Override Navigation Rail.
Moves Help and the site's tools (the Navbar Settings rows, such as System Console) from the menu at the top of the sidebar into the user menu, above Logout.
fields.label: Move Help and Site Tools to User Menu
